Monitor and manage metabolic acidosis with serial venous blood gases and electrolytes.

Continue home insulin pump management with endocrine guidance.
Assess and manage fluid status and electrolytes given hyperglycemia and acidosis.
Perform continuous cardiac monitoring for arrhythmia risk due to electrolyte abnormalities.
Obtain repeat basic metabolic panel and venous blood gas in 6-12 hours to reassess acidosis and electrolytes.
